summary: Real authentication system fully tested. All 16 backend API tests passed. All frontend auth flows working: login page renders with Google OAuth and email/password form, register creates new users, login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard/onboarding, logout clears session and redirects to login, unauthenticated users redirected to /login.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/register - creates new user and returns 200 with user data
POST /api/auth/register - returns 409 for duplicate email
POST /api/auth/register - returns 400 for missing name/email
POST /api/auth/register - returns 400 for password < 6 chars
POST /api/auth/login - returns 200 with user data for valid credentials
POST /api/auth/login - returns 401 for wrong password
POST /api/auth/login - returns 401 for non-existent email
POST /api/auth/login - returns 400 for empty email/password
GET /api/auth/me - returns user data when authenticated
GET /api/auth/me - returns 401 when not authenticated
POST /api/auth/logout - clears session and returns ok:true
Protected endpoints return 401 without session
Protected endpoints work with valid session
Frontend: Login page renders with Google OAuth button (data-testid='google-login-btn')

Frontend: Switch between Login and Register modes works

Frontend: Error message shown for wrong password (data-testid='auth-error-msg')
Frontend: Login redirects to /board or /onboarding based on profile status
Frontend: Logout button in profile dropdown clears session and redirects to /login
Frontend: Unauthenticated users redirected to /login when accessing /board
